conclusion: No inspected shipping startup/service currently keeps the new Root custody, the actual same-Arc task/Cell/Source/drain, live protected Current and the original daemon writer together. The typed library can express a single-process Root embedding, but that is not an existing deployed entry and does not authorize changing the daemon's privilege profile.

paths.path: Existing Root production launch -> permanent credential drop -> daemon
paths.existing: The original AgentdConfig and writer FD remain in the same child. Root handoff completes only for that exact non-Root UID/GID/PID and actual Root session.
paths.refusal: The new custody install/drain explicitly require real/effective UID0. drop_root_native_owner_credentials sets all real/effective/saved UID/GID to the dedicated non-Root identity, drops capabilities and sets no_new_privs. The protected Current store requires original Root-owned 0700 directory/0600 files and takes its actual owner lock on each load/CAS. An earlier directory FD does not exempt future openat operations from kernel permissions.
paths.result: Not a valid place for a post-drop Root callback or for regaining Root.

paths.path: Construct new custody before drop and retain it afterward
paths.existing: Local construction could retain the original task, Cell and current Arcs before credentials change.
paths.refusal: Subsequent require_root/drain still fails after drop, and each protected-store read must use the original Root-only file operations. PreparedRootAgentdConfig also pins same PID and same original writer FD; copying a config or moving it to the separate Root host does not satisfy its finish contract.
paths.result: Lifetime retention alone does not retain Root permissions, and a second independently opened daemon config would compete for the original writer.

paths.path: Separate existing Root authority service plus current daemon
paths.existing: The Root host legitimately opens original issuer/lease/root custody. The daemon legitimately holds its single config/writer and non-Root device/notes consumers.
paths.refusal: The current handoff delivers sealed bootstrap/checkpoint and authenticated channels, not the concrete generation Artifact/FinalUse/Current/task/Cell ownership. Original task retirement checks Arc::ptr_eq with the actual Cell. A second reconstructed Cell, current digest RPC, serialized pointer or arbitrary Current callback does not meet this condition.
paths.result: This is the correct existing deployment split to preserve, but it needs a new narrowly typed task-service boundary; there is no existing one-line attach.

paths.path: Explicit trusted UID0 embedding using the existing typed library
paths.existing: A single process can, at the inspected type/ownership boundary, keep its one valid AgentdConfig, use the real authorities/Prepared or original recovered Ready, consume into_q24_task, retain returned custody, and call the original runtime. No new Current callback or duplicate task is needed.
paths.refusal: No inspected main/Root CLI wires this composition. The Config/runtime paths still require the actual Starting registry record, exclusive writer, identity/fence, AuthBus trust/replay checkpoint/objective profile, real model and owners. The source-level possibility does not establish that operating the normal daemon under UID0 is an authorized or acceptable deployment.
paths.result: A possible explicit embedding design, not a recommendation to bypass the original dedicated non-Root production profile.

minimal_new_boundary_if_current_non_root.status: Engineering proposal only; not implemented or authorized by this memo.
minimal_new_boundary_if_current_non_root.root_side: Keep the concrete original generation Current, Artifact/FinalUse authorities, same PublishedTask, actual factory-created Cell/Source and retirement in one purpose-fixed Root task service. The service must own the actual execution/readback/retirement state, not merely monitor a parallel daemon Cell.
minimal_new_boundary_if_current_non_root.daemon_side: Keep the original AgentdConfig and sole writer in the credential-dropped daemon. Install only a concrete sealed invocation/readback client bound to the original registered daemon identity and authenticated actual Root service.
minimal_new_boundary_if_current_non_root.required_api_change: The current into_q24_task consumes AgentdConfig and returns local config plus custody. A new restricted separation between Root-owned actual task-service construction and daemon-side installation is necessary. Preserve the original factory result; do not expose owners or accept arbitrary trait implementations as proof. This is more than adding one main call.
protocol_minimum: Fixed task/operation/purpose and exact binding, not arbitrary method dispatch.
Original SO_PEERCRED, pidfd, boot/start and registered identity checks.
Same actual Source/Cell/current observations and same-Arc drain remain on the owning side.
No permission from metadata; no new grantor, grant minting, replacement Current or duplicate writer.
Dispatch/ack loss remains Unknown with same-operation readback; no automatic re-dispatch.
minimal_new_boundary_if_current_non_root.why_current_only_rpc_is_insufficient: It would leave the direct Cell/task ownership and Root-only drain split across processes while the original runtime constructors require the concrete local live guard and original same-Arc Cell. It does not solve the actual custody handoff.

implementable_from_existing_typed_owners: A Root-local adapter around original prepare/recover/custody with exact operation binding.
A purpose-specific service that retains the actual original task/Cell/Source and a sealed authenticated client, subject to a separately reviewed ownership/API split.
Original cold Current/journal readback and original uncertainty handling, without initialize fallback or a new grant.
operator_must_supply_or_authorize: Real protected Root state, existing issuer/lease policy and the intended production process/identity registration.
Real Artifact trust, writer lease, signed current head/withdrawal frontier, registry/payload files and signed selected generation.
The actual purpose-bound initial FinalUse authorization and original consumer state with external frontier; no fixture keys or default authority.
Actual model/task/source/fence/journal/independent witness inputs, plus independent B evidence and other real role providers when claiming a complete learning chain.
The deployment choice for a new service/embedding; static code review alone does not grant a Root privilege change.
code_vs_operational_inputs.scope: Independent real task B is not required merely to parse this memo, but is required for the claimed actual learning/real-utility outcome. Mechanism tests and agent cross-checks do not supply it.
